About Convertly

Useful conversions with fewer distractions.

Built around the answer

Convertly brings five everyday conversion categories into one lightweight toolkit: dates, units, data storage, number bases, and text encoding. The goal is simple: make inputs explicit and results easy to use.

Designed to stay lightweight

The converters run locally in your browser. There is no account requirement, database, or file-upload pipeline. Each tool explains its assumptions and limitations alongside the result.

Check important results

Measurement results are rounded for readability. Verify results independently when precision is critical, and check your source unit and timezone before relying on a conversion.
